paragraphs: Mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim, chapter 1, halakhah 4: he was Zavdi ben Levi’s brother and reported in the name of R' Yehoshua ben Levi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The source does not mark the brother phrase as a verbatim quotation; running English preserves Hyman’s possible paraphrase. פ״א ה״ד giveschapter 1 halakhah 4, following supplied dalet against older machine resh, without a named-edition check.

ריב״ל is read contextually as Yehoshua ben Levi, with title component R'. Shalman and Zavdi have no supplied title. The family and reporting relations remain source assertions, not new identity bindings.
